history.content: idk just wanted to log this i guess. everything just feels gray lately. like whats even the point of any of it

I want to check what you mean, gently. When you say that — is it more like being completely worn down and fed up, or are you having thoughts of harming yourself or not feeling safe? Either answer is okay to say here.
no nothing like that i promise. just so tired of all of it. nothing feels worth it lately. like i go to work, come home, repeat, and im just numb
Got it, thank you for clearing that up. "Just so tired of all of it" and numb feels like the center here, with the work-home-repeat part pressing on it.

Not dumb. I’m hearing something gray and worn-down around the part of you that used to like cooking, do you want to stay with that, or leave it here for now?
nah lets leave it here for now. i dunno. thanks for listening i guess. gonna go
Of course, take care of yourself tonight.
